title: Omar Cold Storage Pvt. Ltd. v. Madhyanchal Vidut Vitran Nigam Ltd.
court: High Court of Judicature at Allahabad
coram: Dilip B. Bhosale, C.J. and Yashwant Varma, J.
disposition: Writ dismissed; additional-security challenge fails by companion order
headnote: A consumer writ seeking to quash an April 2014 demand for additional security under para 4.20 of the U.P. Electricity Supply Code, 2005 was dismissed by a Division Bench, which directed that reasons be read from its same-day order in Writ-C No. 30898 of 2016. An earlier 2014 interim restraint on demanding additional security thereby fell with the petition.
facts: Omar Cold Storage Pvt. Ltd. challenged Madhyanchal Vidyut Vitran Nigam Ltd.'s April 2014 demand notice seeking additional security under para 4.20 of the U.P. Electricity Supply Code, 2005. A Division Bench on 29 May 2014 connected the writ with W.P. (C) No. 51884 of 2009, directed exchange of affidavits, and, following an interim order in W.P. No. 51844 of 2009 (Supreme Ceramics), stayed demand of additional security until further orders. On 21 March 2017 a later Division Bench dismissed the petition.

holding_units.holding: A writ petition seeking to quash a demand notice for additional security under para 4.20 of the U.P. Electricity Supply Code, 2005 was dismissed, the Court directing that the reasons be read from its same-day order in Writ-C No. 30898 of 2016.
